Exploring the hidden and historic side of Lahore, Pakistan with Pakistani YouTuber Zeeshan Hussain, popularly known as Baal Wala, who joins us throughout this special Lahore vlog.
Together, we walk through the fascinating streets of Old Lahore, Chuna Mandi and the Heera Mandi area, discovering some incredible historic havelis and hearing the stories connected with Lahore’s past.
